metaTitle: Jaguar Ingenium Diesel Repair (AJ200D) | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Specialist repair for Jaguar Ingenium AJ200D diesel engines. Timing chain replacement, injector seals, and full rebuilds by expert technicians. Get a fixed-price quote.
lede: Full repair and rebuild services for the 2.0-litre Ingenium diesel engine, covering timing chain replacement, injector seal renewal, turbo repairs, and complete engine overhauls. Work carried out in our Essex workshop with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

blocks.html: The AJ200D Ingenium diesel is a sophisticated 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine used across the Jaguar range. Our repair service covers the full scope of work required to restore it to factory specification — from timing chain replacement and injector seal renewal to complete engine rebuilds.

Because the timing chain is mounted at the rear of the engine (flywheel side), access is more involved than conventional front-mounted designs. For longitudinal vehicles (XE, XF, F-Pace) this means the gearbox must be removed; for transverse layouts (E-Pace) the entire powertrain is dropped. We use dedicated Jaguar locking tools and follow OEM torque sequences to ensure precise alignment and long-term reliability.

Every repair includes a full engine flush, new JLR-spec oil and filter, and a road test before handover. Ancillary work such as injector seal replacement and turbo servicing is carried out using genuine components and manufacturer-approved procedures.

steps.title: Inspection & Assessment
steps.body: We carry out a full diagnostic scan (SDD) and visual inspection to determine the exact repair scope. We provide a fixed-price quote before any work begins.

steps.title: Powertrain Access
steps.body: For longitudinal models, we remove the gearbox to access the rear timing chain. For transverse models, we drop the entire engine and gearbox assembly.

steps.title: Disassembly & Component Replacement
steps.body: We strip the engine to the required level, replace all worn components (timing chain, tensioners, guides, injector seals, etc.), and machine any surfaces as needed.

steps.title: Reassembly & Timing
steps.body: Using factory locking tools and torque sequences, we reassemble the engine, set timing precisely, and install a new oil filter and JLR-spec oil.

steps.title: Testing & Road Test
steps.body: We run the engine, check for leaks, perform a full road test, and confirm all systems are operating correctly before handing the vehicle back.

items.q: What does the AJ200D timing chain repair involve?
items.a: It involves removing the gearbox (longitudinal models) or dropping the powertrain (transverse), accessing the rear timing chain, and replacing the chain, guides, and tensioners. We also clean the oil sump and use specialist locking tools to set precise timing.

items.q: How long does an Ingenium diesel repair take?
items.a: Typical timing chain replacement takes 3–5 working days, depending on vehicle layout and any additional work needed. A full rebuild may take longer. We provide a timescale when you book.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on the repair?
items.a: Yes, all our repairs and rebuilds come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.

items.q: Can you collect my non-running vehicle?
items.a: Yes, we offer nationwide engine recovery. Contact us for a quote.
